emission_order.note: Historical predecessor is emitted in order and exact.

known_rules.symptom: First differing instruction is a constant SUB ESP prologue allocation.
known_rules.known_source_cause: Not established by the allocation alone. Different local widths, spills, outgoing arguments, lifetimes or source expansion can change the frame.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Check the attached DWARF local-width evidence and calls before experimenting with register temporaries. Preserve x87 and historical flags; never change a frame size or padding to mask a source mismatch.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Decoded allocation is an observation, not an exact match or source-cause proof.

applicability.limit: Symptom filtering narrows hypotheses; it does not prove the source cause or authorize a repair. Historical example membership alone is not current applicability.

routing_reason: This CU has an unresolved declaration/type prerequisite; repair that interface before body grinding.

routing_evidence.limit: Explains the base heuristic only. Recorded blocks, interface/owner prerequisites and proved bounded recipes take precedence; difficulty is the final routing decision.

callee_interface_scope.limit: Known direct-callee conflicts only. Verified call addresses do not prove declaration/type compatibility. Remote-only conflicts remain visible but do not block a proven local interface; unknown indirect targets are not inferred.

interface_scope.reason: A declaration compiled in this CU differs or lacks complete game-type evidence.

type_layout_issues.reason: Complete aggregate layout/type differs despite any matching declaration spelling

edit_scope: Function body only; use supervisor for prototypes/data/headers or missing implementations.
